validation_checks.V1_safety: any F01 yes (incl. injury_in_treatment) or F36 severe pain -> refer, no plan (v0 F37 removed; its case is F01 injury_in_treatment)
validation_checks.V4_youth: under 18: L1-L2 exercise levels default; floor Olympic only per program; lighter medballs; no research data
validation_checks.V5_older: 60+ (PROPOSED - PENDING COACH APPROVAL): constraint 4-5 bias; never OH squat / snatch / low-bar / depth jumps; few plyos unless asked; step <= 3 %; maintenance >= 70 %
validation_checks.V6_season: plan longer than weeks to the season -> run to the date, taper, switch to in-season
validation_checks.V7_no_equipment: muscle goal without key kit -> warn + buy list
validation_checks.V9_bands: 0 band/chain/releaser exercises, swaps or kit tokens
validation_checks.V10_axial: <= 1 axial squat + <= 1 axial hinge per week
validation_checks.V11_pairing: hip + push, knee + pull in every mixed session
validation_checks.V12_order: warm-up -> core (unless moved) -> athletic -> Olympic -> strength; row before pulldown; the work first
validation_checks.V13_caps: resistance <= 7 (8-9 at 75-90 min); athletes <= 12 + core; minutes <= F24 or superset
validation_checks.V14_counting: athletic work credits no muscle; helpers 0.25; 10/10 = 1 set
validation_checks.V15_step: no week raises total resistance sets by 10 % or more
validation_checks.V16_aesthetics: no medball in the main workout
validation_checks.V17_effort: no MAX on heavy compounds; MYO only last on machine/isolation
validation_checks.V18_minimums: calves 3 sets each leg day; a rear-delt station each week; ~2 core exercises each session
validation_checks.V19_olympic: every athletic week has a level-matched Olympic variant

renderers: xlsx with his columns WEEK/DAY/PURPOSE/CATEGORY/EXERCISE/SETS/REPS/WEIGHT USED or SCORE/EFFORT/HOW IT FELT?/DONE?/VIDEO/NOTES
